title: Public Communication Practice
originality_declaration: Created from scratch for this repository; not derived from a real exam or online question bank.

body.stem: A public notice uses technical terms that many readers do not understand. Which revision is most appropriate?

options.text: Keep the technical terms and remove examples.
Explain key terms in plain language and keep the operational steps visible.
Delay publication until every possible question has been predicted.

body.explanation: Clear public communication should preserve accuracy while making the action path understandable. The exercise was written for this repository.
